title: P0230 — Fuel Pump Primary Circuit

sourcePolicy.notes: Conceptual content. No OEM data, no copyrighted material, no reverse-engineered service procedures. Always cross-check with vehicle-specific OEM documentation.

disclaimer: Conceptual DTC content for educational and triage purposes. Does not replace OEM service information. Always verify pinouts, wire colors, and torque specifications with the vehicle's authorized OEM documentation before any repair.

nodes.name: P0230
nodes.description: Fuel Pump Primary Circuit — generic powertrain code indicating the PCM has detected a fault in the fuel pump's primary control/feed circuit.

nodes.name: No start / extended cranking
nodes.description: Engine cranks but does not start, or requires longer-than-normal cranking before starting.

nodes.name: Engine stall while running
nodes.description: Engine cuts out while driving, often after the fuel rail pressure drops below operating threshold.

nodes.name: Long crank before start
nodes.description: Several seconds of cranking before the engine fires, indicating delayed fuel pressure build-up.

nodes.name: Battery / ground / supply deficiency
nodes.description: Low voltage at the pump circuit due to weak battery, corroded ground, or high-resistance feed.

nodes.name: Fuel pump relay contact failure
nodes.description: Relay contacts pitted, welded, or high-resistance. PCM commands ON but pump receives insufficient voltage.

nodes.name: Fuse / feed circuit open or high-resistance
nodes.description: Fuse blown, corroded, or wiring harness open / chafed between battery and relay/pump.

nodes.name: Connector corrosion or loose pin
nodes.description: Pump-side or relay-side connector corroded, terminal loose, or seal failed.

nodes.name: Pump motor failure
nodes.description: Pump motor brushes worn, locked, or shorted. Last-resort hypothesis — prove with voltage + pressure + amp draw first.

nodes.name: PCM driver / software
nodes.description: PCM internal driver failure or TSB-related software issue. Last hypothesis — only after power, ground, relay, fuse, harness, connector, and pump are all verified good.

profiles.description: Fuel Pump Primary Circuit malfunction detected by the PCM. The PCM monitors the fuel pump control circuit and sets this code when the commanded state does not match the observed state, or when voltage/current falls outside expected range.
diagnosticSteps: Save DTC and freeze frame for record.
Measure battery voltage KOEO (key on, engine off) and compare it with validated vehicle-specific criteria.
Inspect fuel pump fuse for continuity and corrosion.
Activate fuel pump via bidirectional control or key cycle; listen for prime.
Measure voltage at relay control coil (PCM side) and relay output (pump side).
Measure voltage drop across the pump ground path and compare it with a validated vehicle-specific threshold.
Inspect connector terminals for corrosion, spread, or backing-out.
Only after all of the above check out, perform pump current draw test.
PCM driver is the final hypothesis; do not replace PCM based on this code alone.

nodes.question: Battery voltage KOEO meets validated vehicle-specific criteria?
nodes.howToTest: Multimeter on battery posts, key ON, engine OFF.
nodes.expectedValue: Use a reviewed source for the exact vehicle, market and test condition.

nodes.question: Charge or replace battery, then retest.
nodes.howToTest: Battery charger or replacement per OEM.
nodes.expectedValue: Battery passes the validated test criteria for the installed battery type.

nodes.question: Fuel pump fuse continuity OK?
nodes.howToTest: Pull fuse, multimeter continuity, inspect for corrosion.
nodes.expectedValue: Continuity and physical condition pass the validated inspection criteria.

nodes.question: Replace fuse. Same code after?
nodes.howToTest: Install correct-rated fuse, clear code, drive cycle.
nodes.expectedValue: Code does not return.

nodes.question: Relay control coil receives PCM command?
nodes.howToTest: Back-probe relay coil terminals with PCM commanded ON.
nodes.expectedValue: The commanded state matches the reviewed vehicle-specific circuit behavior.

nodes.question: Relay output voltage to pump passes the validated loaded-circuit criteria?
nodes.howToTest: Measure output terminal with pump commanded ON.
nodes.expectedValue: Use the reviewed vehicle-specific voltage-drop criterion.

nodes.question: Replace relay. Code clear after drive cycle?
nodes.howToTest: Install new relay, clear code, drive cycle.
nodes.expectedValue: Code does not return.

nodes.question: Pump connector terminals clean and tight?
nodes.howToTest: Inspect, clean, retest.
nodes.expectedValue: No corrosion, no spread, full engagement.

nodes.question: Repair or replace connector.
nodes.howToTest: Replace terminal or pigtail, retest.
nodes.expectedValue: The repaired connection passes the reviewed loaded-circuit criterion.

nodes.question: Pump feed voltage passes the validated loaded-circuit criteria?
nodes.howToTest: Back-probe pump feed wire with pump commanded ON.
nodes.expectedValue: Use the reviewed vehicle-specific voltage-drop criterion.

nodes.question: Pump ground passes the validated loaded voltage-drop test?
nodes.howToTest: Measure pump ground terminal to chassis ground.
nodes.expectedValue: Use the reviewed vehicle-specific ground voltage-drop criterion.

nodes.question: Repair ground path (clean, tighten, add supplemental ground if OEM allows).
nodes.howToTest: Retest voltage drop after repair.
nodes.expectedValue: The repaired ground passes the reviewed loaded-circuit criterion.

nodes.question: Pump current draw within OEM range?
nodes.howToTest: Clamp ammeter on pump feed wire, command pump ON.
nodes.expectedValue: Use a reviewed source for this exact pump, vehicle and test condition.

nodes.question: Replace pump. Code clear after drive cycle?
nodes.howToTest: Install new pump, prime, clear code, drive cycle.
nodes.expectedValue: Code does not return; normal fuel pressure.

nodes.question: Harness and connectors between battery, fuse, relay, and pump all intact?
nodes.howToTest: Visual inspection + continuity test on each conductor.
nodes.expectedValue: Each conductor passes reviewed continuity and loaded voltage-drop criteria.

nodes.question: Repair or replace damaged wiring per OEM spec.
nodes.howToTest: Continuity retest after repair.
nodes.expectedValue: The repaired circuit passes reviewed continuity and loaded voltage-drop criteria.

nodes.question: PCM driver TSB / scan tool actuation test?
nodes.howToTest: Run OEM bidirectional test, check TSB list for known PCM driver issues.
nodes.expectedValue: Driver commands output, TSB applies if listed.

nodes.question: Apply TSB per OEM. Code clear after?
nodes.howToTest: Per TSB; typically reflash or driver update.
nodes.expectedValue: Code does not return.

nodes.question: Escalate to OEM-trained specialist for PCM diagnosis.
nodes.howToTest: Out of scope for generalist.
nodes.expectedValue: Per specialist.

nodes.question: Repair complete. Drive cycle confirms monitor ready and code does not return.
nodes.howToTest: Drive cycle per OEM; verify readiness monitor.
nodes.expectedValue: Monitor COMPLETE; code absent.
